SELECT IFNULL(SUM(entry_time >= #{begin}), 0) AS todayEntryCount, IFNULL(SUM(exit_time >= #{begin}), 0) AS todayExitCount FROM entry_exit_record WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND entry_time < #{end}
AND lot_id = #{lotId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalSpaces, IFNULL(SUM(status = 2), 0) AS occupiedSpaces, IFNULL(SUM(status = 1), 0) AS freeSpaces FROM parking_space WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND lot_id = #{lotId}
